text: N=128 seeds 20-21 on data_seed 1 reach val_mse_ratio 0.0096/0.0083 at step 12000 and are still gaining force (about +0.002 per 500 steps), while seed 21's N=64 minus N=128 gap shrank from about 0.077 at step 6000 to about 0.064 at step 12000. If both arms are read at matched val_mse_ratio, or N=128 is trained to 24000 steps, does seed 21's gap fall below 0.04, the same pattern as seed 23 on data_seed 0?
